title: 3 way tap vacuum gas manifold
description:
vacuum gas manifold 3 way tap

1:  Inert gas in
2:  Inert gas out
3:  Vacuum
4:  Reaction line
5:  Double oblique stopcock (i.e. a glass tap with 2 separate parallel 'channels/lines' that run diagonal to the axis of the tap.)
